note: CC quasielastic-like (CCQE-like, topology: muon + 0-or-more nucleons, no mesons/heavy baryons) nu_mu scattering, NuMI "Medium Energy" neutrino-mode beam (flux peaked ~6 GeV), MINERvA tracker. Three flux-integrated 1D differential cross sections from the official arXiv ancillary data release (anc/tables/, described by anc/tables.html): dsigma/dQ^2_QE (single-differential, the paper's Fig. "XSec1D" headline plot), and dsigma/dp_parallel and dsigma/dp_perp (muon longitudinal/transverse momentum), which are the OFFICIAL 1D marginal projections of the paper's headline 2D d^2sigma/dp_perp/dp_parallel result, released with their own independently-tabulated covariances. Target: per nucleon (CH hydrocarbon tracker: 88.5% C, 8.2% H, 2.5% O by mass in the fiducial region, per paper Sec. "central scintillator tracker region"). Paper text: efficiency-corrected distributions "normalized by the integral of the predicted neutrino flux and by the number of nucleons (3.23e30 in the fiducial region)" -- i.e. divided by total nucleon count, not just neutrons, so per NuIntBib convention this is tagged CH (per-nucleon), not C..
